title: Identify the first possible f subshell
statement:
What is the smallest possible n for an f subshell?

[_]{a}

explanations: The first allowed f subshell is 4f.
A 5f subshell is valid but not the first.
The n=2 shell allows only ℓ=0 and 1.

hints: The f letter corresponds to ℓ=3.
The maximum allowed ℓ is n−1.
solution: The f letter corresponds to ℓ=3. The maximum allowed ℓ is n−1. Solve 3≤n−1. The first allowed f subshell is 4f.
